mapper.sql: l.id, l.prisoner_id, l.prisoner_no, COALESCE(p.name, l.name) AS name, COALESCE(p.cell, l.cell) AS cell, l.work_type, l.work_place, l.work_hours, l.work_score, l.status, l.assign_date, l.remark, l.create_time, l.update_time
FROM prison_labor l LEFT JOIN prison_prisoner p ON p.prisoner_no = l.prisoner_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prison_labor (prisoner_id, prisoner_no, name, cell, work_type, work_place, work_hours, work_score, status, assign_date, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{prisonerId}, #{prisonerNo}, #{name}, #{cell}, #{workType}, #{workPlace}, #{workHours}, #{workScore}, #{status}, #{assignDate}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE prison_labor SET work_type = #{workType}, work_place = #{workPlace}, work_hours = #{workHours}, work_score = #{workScore}, status = #{status}, assign_date = #{assignDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
